title: Spider-Man 2
description: Tobey Maguire returns as the Webbed Wonder, battling evil in New York with Kirsten Dunst at his side. Action-packed superhero sequel.

description: Super-powered action as Spidey (Tobey Maguire) battles his inner demons while Sandman and Venom plot to take him down. Violence/flashing images.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
description: Andrew Garfield stars as the Webbed Wonder, on a collision course with evil adversary The Lizard. With Emma Stone. Violence/flashing images.
